- Super Owner-only settings, pending request list, short-lived signed evidence access, and version-checked accept/reject decisions.
- Acceptance writes the manual-review verification lease, 1,500 BetaCoins balance credit and ledger entry in one Firestore transaction, with deterministic idempotency key, notification and audit record.
- Biometric lease renews after one calendar month; the existing email cycle remains 90 days. Three failed biometric attempts trigger a separate 90-day lockout.

body:
## المرحلة الاقتصادية الشاملة — متابعة التنفيذ والتدقيق

### التغييرات المنفذة في الفرع
- تعزيز سقوف مكافآت الإعلانات الزمنية اليومية داخل معاملة المحفظة.
- إضافة تدقيقات موثقة لاقتصاد المكالمات وMedia Saver مع إبقاء الفجوات واضحة.
- إضافة دورة إهداء مزايا المتاجر خادمياً مع تحقق المستلم، الخصم الذري، ledger، سجل الهدية، الاستحقاق، الإشعار، وتمديد الاستحقاق الزمني.
- نقل نقطة بدء إهداء المزايا إلى ملف المستلم حصراً، وإزالة زر الإهداء من شاشة المتجر. المستلم يحدد من الملف المفتوح، دون البحث بأسماء المستخدمين.
- إضافة سجل الهدايا المستلمة إلى شاشة العضو.
- زر إهداء Beta Coins في ملف المستلم يعرض خيارين:
  1. باقة من الباقات التي يديرها المالك. مسار الشراء الحالي يدوي؛ يسجل طلباً، ويرسل المالك تعليمات الدفع، ولا تصل الكوينز للمستلم إلا بعد توثيق المالك للتحقق من الدفع واعتماد الطلب. عند الاعتماد تُضاف الكمية إلى المستلم وليس المشتري، مع ledger وسجل هدية وإشعار ذري.
  2. مبلغ يختاره المرسل من رصيده الحالي؛ يستخدم عرض التحويل الحالي ويعرض الخصم الإجمالي والعمولة والصافي، ثم يخصم خادمياً ويضيف الصافي للمستلم.
- إضافة تحقق خادمي لأهلية مستلم باقة Beta Coins واستبعاد حسابات الزوار، وربط الطلب بمعرف ملف المستلم ومنع self-gifting وإعادة استخدام request ID مع مستلم مختلف.
- تحديث سجل الهدايا ليشمل باقات Beta Coins المهداة.
- تحديث سجلات القرارات والتدقيق.

### نتائج التدقيق والفجوات المتبقية
- المكالمات: لا تزال دورة الاستحقاق وموافقة الخصم الصريحة من الطرفين والقياس الموثوق والتسوية والـLedger غير مكتملة.
- Media Saver: لا تزال دورة الحفظ المحلي end-to-end والتحقق الخادمي لكل عملية حفظ غير مكتملة.
- الإعلان المميز ومساحة الوسائط الآمنة وبقية المتاجر تحتاج استكمال تكامل واختبارات.
- لا تعتبر حدود مكافآت الإعلان أو اختبارات الوحدات دليلاً على قبول المرحلة الاقتصادية كاملة.

### الاختبارات والقبول
- أضيفت اختبارات نطاقية للتحقق من طلبات باقات Beta Coins الموجهة لمستلم، ورفض استخدام مسار الطلب المخصص لهذه الهدايا.
- اختبارات الإهداء وFunctions/Firestore Emulator وFlutter Analyze/Tests لم تُشغّل في هذه البيئة. لا أدّعي نجاح build أو tests.
- آخر SHA: `d0838b23b30d0ef9339d0f126f0cd9ebe4acc433`.
- لا توجد نتيجة CI مؤكدة على SHA الحالي.

### ضوابط السيادة
- PR Draft وغير مدمج.
- لا دمج إلى main، لا نشر، لا تعديل Firebase إنتاجي، لا فوترة أو دفع حقيقي. مسار الباقات اليدوي لا يصدر كوينز قبل اعتماد المالك بعد التحقق الخارجي.


### Currency brand naming standard — 2026-11-18
- Standardized user-facing currency name to the exact single English word **BetaCoins** (no space) across the wallet, profile, store, purchase flows, owner coin-request screens, member gift history, featured-ad rewards, room-rental pricing, economy pricing, super-admin controls, server-side error messages, in-app notifications, and push notification copy.

## Security hardening

- Carry the server-recorded media purpose from the Firestore media asset into the authenticated scanner request and signed verdict callback.

- Align guest and member room microphone UI timers with the server-enforced 60-second cap. File-picker uploads exceeding the cap are rejected in quarantine by the scanner rather than being served.
- Add scanner tests for purpose validation and per-purpose duration limits.

This is a Draft hardening PR targeting the Mawdda implementation PR branch; it is not merged and does not deploy to production.

The branch already enforces the approved 60-second live microphone cap for both direct chat and room recordings, and the trusted scanner validates chat/room purpose with the same 60-second limit. ## Mawdda Test Center — current scope

This PR builds an isolated, repeatable test foundation for Mawdda Platform 2026.

### Implemented in this branch
- Five named personas: guest preview, full email member, biometric member, counterparty member, and owner operator.
- Guest desired policy is encoded in fixtures and unit assertions: one hour per rolling 24 hours; public rooms only; text/audio send and receive only; no direct/private messaging or other media.
- Explicit capability names distinguish guest text/audio sending from receiving.
- Complete Arabic sample profile fixtures and a shared full-member capability baseline for the three member identities.
- Emulator-only Auth/Firestore provisioner that creates test Auth identities plus canonical `users/{uid}` records and separate `testAccountProfiles` metadata.
- Local random credentials written to an ignored, owner-readable file; no credentials are committed.
- A feature coverage matrix with 15+ journeys spanning authentication, guest boundaries, profiles, messaging, media, wallet/transfers, stores/entitlements, room rentals, biometrics, owner MFA, safety, notifications, reliability and authorization rules.
- A seeded cross-persona integration journey that transfers coins between the provisioned email member and counterparty, verifies both ledgers, commission and idempotent replay, then restores fixture balances.
- A unified backend test command, operator runbook, and GitHub Actions workflow for Flutter analyze/tests/web build plus backend emulator suites.

### Guest implementation boundary — release blocker
- The guest fixture defines the approved behavior: 60 minutes per rolling 24-hour window; public rooms only; text and audio messages may be sent and received; private/direct messaging, private rooms, wallet/rewards/purchases, gifts, room rental, images, GIFs, video and documents are denied.
- The full application/backend branch does not yet implement this guest room experience or a server-authoritative guest session timer. The current Flutter anonymous-user screen is an upgrade screen, while `joinRoom` and `sendRoomMessage` require a completed member record.
- `test:guest-privacy-integration` currently tests anonymous-versus-member privacy acknowledgement only. It does not test public-room membership, text/audio exchange, 60-minute expiry, or 24-hour cooldown.
- The coverage matrix and runbook now mark those runtime scenarios as planned/not implemented rather than claiming them as passed. Guest room access must preserve the platform's age-segmented room rules; no age or audience restriction may be bypassed.

### Security invariants
- All three member personas share the ordinary member capability baseline. They never inherit owner privileges.
- Owner operations still require the real MFA-backed authorization contract. The seed script does not create an owner claim or bypass MFA.
- Member PDF/document exchange remains denied; owner document capability is separate.
- Payments remain sandbox-only; wallet changes use server transactions.
- A biometric fixture is not hardware proof. The backend local-prompt reward endpoint accepts a client-reported local-auth success value; that trust boundary requires device-key/attestation hardening and real-device validation before a public pilot.

### Validation status — do not treat as release approval
- An earlier CI run completed Flutter dependency setup and `flutter analyze` successfully.
- The first full backend CI run exposed two failures in the newly added coverage-matrix validator (188 passed / 2 failed); both validator defects were corrected in later commits.
- GitHub Actions run [43592938087](https://github.com/productionhome2022-hash/mawda-platform/actions/runs/43592938087) passed both Test Center jobs on head commit `d89d30a623369e5b687525297b97257192a27462`: Flutter analyze/tests/Web release build; and the complete backend emulator test-center command with 279 tests across 19 test invocations, 279 passed / 0 failed. The emulator seeder provisioned four email identities, and the seeded member-to-member transfer, ledgers, commission and idempotent replay passed. This validates the test-center branch state only; it does not implement or prove the guest public-room runtime journeys described above.
- The in-app Test Center dashboard, real Android/iOS biometric anti-spoof validation, real-device camera/microphone checks, sandbox payment-provider validation and full Flutter UI-to-backend E2E journeys remain required before calling this a complete launch-ready lab.

No PR merge, staging deployment or production deployment is performed by this change.

This draft is closed as superseded to avoid duplicate/conflicting integration; the development branch remains the source of truth. No changes were merged to `main`.

The audit found that the backend required a second-factor claim for sensitive owner callables, but the Flutter sign-in screen did not resolve Firebase's MFA challenge. This could lock the real owner out after enrolling MFA.

- Firebase Authentication with Identity Platform and TOTP MFA must be enabled for the Firebase project.

- iOS Face ID usage description and bundle-ID verification.
- A GitHub Actions workflow that builds an Android debug APK and an iOS no-code-sign build, then commits the generated native directories to the development branch only after both builds pass.

No production deployment, signing credentials, or merge to `main` is involved. This is a development-branch scaffold and build validation, not physical-device acceptance.

Acceptance grants 1,500 BetaCoins exactly once through the shared central wallet-ledger primitive.
